name: service-tc
description: Node application designed to run as a Windows service and call a web service daily.

scripts.package:win:process: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/EntryPoint/bundle.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/Service-TC.exe
scripts.package:win:run-once: npm run build:bundle:run-once && pkg dist/EntryPoint/run-once.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/Service-TC-run-once.exe
scripts.package:win:installer: npm run build && pkg --config package.json dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/Service-TC-install.exe
scripts.package:win: npm run package:win:process && npm run package:win:run-once && npm run package:win:installer
scripts.service:install: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js install
scripts.service:start: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js start
scripts.service:stop: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js stop
scripts.service:restart: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js restart
scripts.service:uninstall: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js uninstall
